name: [Ayato1 + 2!] Ro-Ghoul [ALPHA]
desc:
- Accessories aside from hair gets removed.
- Do not cheat or ruin the game for others, moderation will ban you for bad behavior.
- The game is still receiving updates.
- Do not put your account information into any game, be safe!
- Please check out the social links and follow the game!
- Gyakusatsu does not spawn in private servers, and hearts are not obtainable in private servers!
- Click <//> in game for codes menu.

Controls:
- Toggle Weapon, Toggle Armor (CCG): 1-9, 0
- Dash: Shift / Double Tap + W / A / S / D
- Block: Q, T
- Attack: Left Click / MB1
- Special 1, 2, 3, Bonus: E, R, F, C
- Sprint: X
- Mask: M
- Special/Quinx: G
- Mouse-Lock: Left Ctrl / Left Alt
- Quick Menu: V
- Leaderboard: Tab

Thank you everyone for supporting me and my game (:
